text:
1921 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400).  
210 days before 1921-12-01:  
October has 31 days, September 30, August 31, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28.  
Back from Dec 1:  
Nov 30 days → Dec 1 to Nov 1 is 30 days (210 - 30 = 180 left).  
Oct 31 → 180 - 31 = 149 left.  
Sep 30 → 149 - 30 = 119 left.  
Aug 31 → 119 - 31 = 88 left.  
Jul 31 → 88 - 31 = 57 left.  
Jun 30 → 57 - 30 = 27 left.  
May 31 → 27 - 31 = -4, so go into May: May 31 - 4 days = May 27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1921-05-27
